title: Credit Hire Claims Handler
description:
Credit Hire Claims Handler
Location: Manchester City Centre (Office-based during probation)
Working Hours: 40 hours per week
Salary: £32,000 + 10% Discretionary Bonus

IPS Group is working with an innovative and fast-growing InsurTech that is continuing to expand its UK claims operation. Due to ongoing growth, they are looking to appoint a Credit Hire Claims Handler to join their newly established claims team in Manchester.
This is a great opportunity to join the business at an exciting stage of its journey. As one of the early hires within the claims function, you'll have the chance to make a real impact, contribute to the development of processes and customer outcomes, and position yourself for future progression as the team continues to grow.

The Role
You will manage your own caseload of third-party Credit Hire claims from instruction through to settlement or litigation. Working closely with clients, claimants, insurers and third parties, you'll be responsible for progressing claims efficiently while delivering positive outcomes throughout the claims journey. The role will involve reviewing liability, handling quantum disputes, assessing supporting evidence and negotiating settlements. You'll also review payment packs, utilise Verify as part of the claims process and identify any potentially fraudulent activity or underwriting concerns where appropriate.
As the UK operation continues to grow, you'll play an important role in helping shape processes and delivering an excellent customer experience.

Key Responsibilities Include:
- Managing a caseload of third-party Credit Hire claims from instruction through to settlement or litigation
- Reviewing liability and handling quantum disputes
- Liaising with clients, claimants, insurers and third parties to progress claims efficiently
- Reviewing payment packs and utilising Verify within the claims process
- Negotiating settlements and achieving commercially focused outcomes
- Maintaining accurate claim records, reserves and payments
- Delivering excellent levels of customer service throughout the claims lifecycle

About You:
You'll have previous Credit Hire claims experience and be confident managing your own caseload with minimal supervision. Ideally, you'll have at least two years' experience handling motor-related Credit Hire claims from inception through to settlement.
You will also have:
- A strong understanding of UK motor insurance principles and claims processes
- Knowledge of liability assessment, indemnity and quantum calculations
- The ability to investigate claims, review evidence and make sound decisions
- A proactive approach and the ability to work effectively within a fast-paced environment

What's in it for You?
Alongside a competitive salary, you'll benefit from private medical cover, life insurance, pension support and overtime enhancements where applicable. The role is hybrid following probation, with the opportunity to have 1 day working from home.

This is also a rare opportunity to join a newly established claims function within a growing InsurTech business. As one of the first members of the team, you'll have genuine opportunities to develop your career as the operation expands, whilst helping to shape the future success of the team.

If you're looking for a fresh challenge within a modern, technology-driven insurer and want to play a key role in a growing claims department, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Digital Experience Manager
description:
About The Role
At Domino's, your skills, ideas and judgement really matter. As our Digital Experience Manager, you'll shape and improve the customer journey across our app, website and Dom Central-powered systems.

From discovering the right deal to completing checkout, you'll help make every interaction intuitive, consistent and high-performing. You'll use customer insight, digital data and experimentation to identify what could work better, then bring Product, UX, Marketing, CRM, Operations and Technology teams together to deliver the change.

Based in Manchester, you'll also manage and develop one direct report, giving them the clarity, coaching and support they need to do great work.
What You'll Bring
You understand how customers behave online and what makes an end-to-end ecommerce journey work. You're comfortable moving between customer insight, commercial priorities and delivery, turning complex findings into clear recommendations that people can act on.
You'll bring:
- Experience improving digital customer journeys across websites, apps or other ecommerce platforms.
- A good understanding of ecommerce trading, including conversion, promotions, merchandising and onsite content.
- Practical knowledge of UX, conversion rate optimisation and test-and-learn approaches.
- The ability to interpret analytics, customer feedback and journey data to identify friction and prioritise improvements.
- Clear communication skills, with the confidence to influence Product, UX, Technology, Marketing, CRM and Operations teams.
- Strong organisation and attention to detail, particularly when managing campaigns, content, quality assurance and competing priorities.
- The ability to manage and develop a direct report through clear direction, coaching and constructive feedback.

A degree or professional qualification is not essential for this position.
What You'll Be Doing
You'll connect insight with action. That means understanding where customers encounter friction, working with the right teams to improve the experience and measuring whether the changes have delivered the intended result.
You'll:
- Optimise the digital customer journey: Use customer behaviour, feedback and performance data to improve journeys across app and web, from onboarding and menu exploration through to checkout and post-purchase interactions.
- Turn insight into better experiences: Work with Product, UX, Research, Data and Technology teams on experimentation, CRO and UX priorities, making sure customer discovery and testing inform delivery.
- Strengthen execution and performance: Oversee onsite campaigns, content and promotional activity; maintain accurate product information; track digital and customer-journey KPIs; and improve processes that prevent broken journeys or recurring errors.

You'll also contribute to the wider digital experience strategy, provide clear recommendations to senior stakeholders and help align teams around the improvements that matter most to customers and the business.
How We Will Support You
Bring your flavour, and we'll back your future. This role gives you the space to build your digital expertise, develop your leadership skills and influence work that reaches customers across Domino's digital channels.
Here's what you can expect:
- A clear induction, with the context and support you need to understand our digital ecosystem, priorities and ways of working.
- Support from your manager and the wider team, alongside the autonomy to use your judgement and shape how digital-experience improvements are delivered.
- Opportunities to broaden your strategic exposure by working across Product, UX, Data, Marketing, CRM, Operations and Technology.
- Support to grow as a people manager, helping you give clear direction, develop talent and create consistently high standards.
- Recognition for great work, from everyday appreciation to wider moments such as our Domi Awards.

Our employer brand is built around growth, belonging, recognition, wellbeing and giving people space to shape their role with support to succeed.

About The Company
Domino's UK & Ireland
Who are we? A forward-thinking, inclusive world's leading pizza company:
Domino's is the world's leading pizza company, with over 1,300 stores across the UK and Ireland. We're committed to using the freshest, highest-quality ingredients to create over 110 million delectable pizzas each year. Plus, we're a tech-savvy and data driven bunch - 90% of our system sales come through digital channels and 75% of our digital orders coming via the app we have 9.5 million active app customers!
Our mission? To be the go-to choice for food delivery and collection by crafting hot, freshly made pizzas that earn us accolades and the loyalty of millions of pizza enthusiasts worldwide. We're all about innovation, growth, and a commitment to excellence.
At Domino's, we embrace the power of diversity and foster an inclusive environment where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered. We celebrate the uniqueness of each individual, regardless of their identity, background, or any other characteristic. When you join our team, you join a family that welcomes and celebrates authenticity!
Our recipe for success? Our DomiDNA:
- We Mean Business
- We Always Deliver
- We're Open to New Flavours
- We're Tastier Together

If you share our values and are ready to be part of a world-class team that's as passionate about people as we are about pizza, apply now and join the Domino's UK & Ireland family!
